effective_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration_parameters.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.
